gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-almendra: Letters pushed far apart, low ascenders sitting over big round bowls: that is Ethnocentric, fast and aggressive. Almendra counters with a dignified text serif whose lowercase has a deep midsection.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-bree-serif: Ethnocentric spreads its letters wide, with short ascenders above big bowls and curves that never clog, so it reads fast and aggressive. Bree Serif follows in a literary, refined voice with oversized lowercase.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-port-lligat-s: Aggressive and quick, Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart while Port Lligat Slab hugs its own close. Its text serif counters open like portholes, so paragraphs feel literary and traditional, with curves left room to breathe.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-quando: Fast and aggressive, Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart over big bowls and short ascenders. Quando brings the opposite temperament, bookish and traditional, with sparse spacing and a big, tall middle zone in every word.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-outfit: Ethnocentric stretches its letters apart, with short ascenders hovering above big bowls and a low, fast stance. And Outfit meets it with a line like bent cable, clean and approachable, in moderate-height lowercase.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-plus-jakarta-san: Plus Jakarta Sans is modern and precise, a monoline sans whose curve endings stay well apart under the wide-set aggression of Ethnocentric. Size it moderately, since its lowercase is shorter than the heading's.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-sora: Sora draws geometric, precise letters whose curves turn corners without any pressure swell, and its c and s stay widely parted. Ethnocentric is the fast, aggressive one with tall lowercase and short ascenders; Sora holds the moderate ground.
gen-dafont-existence-bitter: Existence cuts every glyph from equal visual mass, with porthole counters and terminals stopping well short of the bowl. Bitter's strongest quality is dependability, a grounded slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye.
gen-dafont-existence-fs-chillax: Industrial and modern, Existence builds its letters with the same visual mass throughout and wide porthole counters. Chillax loosens things into spaghetti-like casual lines, so a small heading would lose its footing against a large body.
gen-dafont-existence-fs-familjen-grotesk: Existence looks cut from strips of equal width, with porthole counters. Familjen Grotesk, neutral yet lively, leaves bowls unfinished on one side, so a longer passage moves with a light, tall-lowercase bounce.
